sql: SELECT 'live_orders_12h_by_tag' AS what, COALESCE(strategy,'-') AS k, count(*)::text||' last='||to_char(max(created_at),'HH24:MI:SS') AS v FROM live_orders WHERE created_at > now() - interval '12 hours' GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 'drift_detail', left(e.kind,40), COALESCE(left(e.description,300),'-') FROM experiment_integrity_events e WHERE e.resolved_at IS NULL AND e.severity='error' ORDER BY 1,2
